{{Infobox auto}}

'''Ice cream''' is a cold dessert that heals {{Hp|8}} and removes harmful effects.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/ice_cream.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
A snowball, a [[Milk Bottle|milk bottle]], sugar, a blue orchid and [[bread]] (or naan). Picking up a snowball unlocks the recipe. The milk bottle's glass bottle is meant to be given back, but in 1.12.2-beta the advancement that returns it still names the recipe by an old ID, so it is used up.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/mechanics/glass_bottle_from_crafting.json}}</ref>

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating ice cream takes 1.3 seconds, heals {{Hp|8}} and removes the same maleffects as [[bread]]. It leaves a [[bowl]] behind, although the recipe doesn't use one.

=== Trading ===
{{Upcoming|type=section}}
It is one of the foods a villager will be able to ask for as its [[favorite food]].
